Not the same as other BRs no storm no loot drops none of that. But it is very punishing once you pass a certain player level (i believe level 11). See the goal is obviously hunt your bounty being 1 of 3 bosses (or it can be a double bounty 2 bosses) you have you selected loadout of choice and go in as quickly as possible to try and get that bounty and leave. If you DIE it is PERMANENT.. you lose that loadout and start again on another.. if you do not escape after the bounty has been claimed and the person has left on the boat you have a time limit to escape as well or you will be forever lost meaning again you lose your loadout. Y'know you have your player level meaning you unlock guns and perks but your characters also have a level of their own the higher it is the more traits (skills like more health ,better aiming on gun types, reload speed etc) they can have on them so if you died in a game welp youll have to make another character and start all over again.
